main_measure.name: pooled OLS slope of the 18-bar forward return minus the coin's mean 18-bar return, on the forecast
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2; at least 300 grid cases with forecast > 0

decided_by: The slope is positive with t >= 2, over at least 300 grid cases with forecast > 0.
reading: The regression is pooled OLS with an intercept over all grid cases, flat cases included, with the drift taken as each coin's mean 18-bar grid return over all its windows; following the workflow, fewer than 300 grid cases with forecast > 0 is reported as 'not observable'.
